Privacy information

This page explains, in plain words, what information this website handles. It is general information and may be updated if the website changes.

Who we are

Elysian Dental Lounge, RAJA TOWERS, 2/461, Medavakkam Main Rd, Medavakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600129. Phone: +91 94980 52828 or +91 94980 62828.

The appointment enquiry form

When you send an enquiry we receive the details you type in: your name, phone number, preferred date and time, the treatment you pick, and an optional message. We use them only to contact you about your appointment.

Please do not write medical history or other sensitive health details in the message box. The dentist will ask about these in person.

The form is delivered by a service called Web3Forms, which passes your enquiry to the clinic by email. Your enquiry is only shown as sent when that service confirms it.

If you arrive through a campaign link (one that contains utm_ labels), the label is kept for your current visit only and is added to your enquiry so we know which link brought you.

WhatsApp, phone, maps and social media

The WhatsApp buttons, the optional “send these details on WhatsApp” button, and our Instagram and Facebook links take you to those services. They have their own privacy terms. Nothing is sent to WhatsApp unless you press Send there.

Cookies and what is stored on your device

This website does not use advertising or tracking cookies, and it does not run visitor analytics. Your browser keeps three small things on your own device only: your light/dark choice, whether you have dismissed the privacy notice, and (for the current visit) any campaign label described above.

Content from other companies

The page fonts and the embedded map are loaded from Google. When they load, Google can receive your internet address and browser details, as with any website that uses these services.

Your choices

To ask us to correct or delete details you have sent us, call us on +91 94980 52828 or +91 94980 62828.

If we ever add analytics or other tools that collect visitor data, we will update this page first.
